create_freeze_mujoco_context: create a FreezeMujoco context manager to temporarily freeze and restore a MuJoCo gym environment state
make_env_from_string: build a MuJoCo gym environment from a string name like HalfCheetah-v4 or pets_cartpole
get_current_mujoco_state: get the current position, velocity, and elapsed steps state from a MuJoCo environment
set_mujoco_env_state: set a MuJoCo environment back to a previously saved state including position and velocity
check_is_mujoco_env: test whether a gymnasium TimeLimit environment is a MuJoCo-backed environment
